name: LineageOS 17.1 for douglas
body:
- Restored functionality for early suspend.
- Transitioned to a generic variant for the CPU.
- Activated GL composition backpressure.
- Incorporated support for MicroG (signature spoofing).
- Introduced UKSM (Ultra Kernel Samepage Merging).
- Fine-tuned MEMCG settings (swappiness) for devices with lower RAM.
- Implemented support for dynamic loading of Bluetooth device names.
- Made partial fixes to FBE encryption (it's not yet compatible with lockscreen).
- Borrowed and updated the network stack from Umidigi F2, aligning it with the most recent HIDLs.

name: LineageOS 17.1 for douglas
LineageOS 17.1 for douglas
body:
-  Fixed Wi-Fi not connecting to certain routers.
-  Fixed OOM issues when trying to use some playback apps.
-  Introduced Ultra Kernel Samepage Merging (UKSM).
-  Introduced a new HIDL-based lights HAL.
-  Fixed wrong bootanimation resolution.
-  Switched to LZ4 ZRAM compression.
-  Added WireGuard support.

name: LineageOS 17.1 for douglas
body:
- Fixed all the sensors.
- Fixed shutter button location in Snap (for tablet UI).
- Switched to tablet characteristics/features.

name: LineageOS 17.1 for douglas
body:
* Added ADB only config (fixes ADB on boot).
* Switched to minimal LineageOS configs.
* Switched to LZ4 compression for ZRAM.
* Disabled vsync for CPU rendered apps.
* Enabled IORap app prefetching.
* Switched back to software gatekeeper hidl.

name: LineageOS 17.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
- Enabled DVFS support.
- Switched to HIDL PowerHAL.
- Added support for Amazon's dynamic boost impl.
- Fixed installation errors on giza.

name: LineageOS 17.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
- Initial build
- Audio works
- Bluetooth works
- Camera (only videos/rear camera) works
- Software encode/decode works
- DRM (L1) works
- Wi-Fi works
- USB (MTP, PTP, etc) works
- Permissive SELinux

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
- Resolved missing {drm,omx} symbols ({TimedEventQueue,EVP}).
- Added MicroG support (Signature Spoofing).
- Added exFAT support (included new kernel driver).
- Fixed audio stream (amazon proprietary libraries).
- Added _GPU Extension Device_ ("GED") support.
- Updated the security patch to October 2021.

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
- Fixed USB tethering.
- Added support for MTK's perfnative handles.
- Updated vendor blobs to the latest FireOS version.
- Defined the vendor security patch (to satisfy Trust).
- Cleaned up unused vendor blobs & patches.
- Fixed MicroG spoof patch.

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
* Fixed Video Recording.
* Fixed Hardware Decoding/Encoding.

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
* Updated sdcardFS to 2.0.
* Updated the exFAT driver.
* Fixed detection of external SDs.

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
- General cleanup of the common tree
- Fixed MicroG support (signature spoofing)
- Fixed and re-enabled sdcardFS
- Fixed direct Magisk installation/update (supports amonet now)
- Enabled USB MIDI support
- Enabled OTG ethernet support

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
* Updated vcodec libraries.
* Fixed internal storage issues (disabled sdcardFS).
* Removed amazon/mediatek kernel logging.
* Resolved missing libraries/symbols.
* Converted audio_effects.conf to audio_effects.xml.
* Switched back to stock libcam.utils.sensorlistener.so.
* Introduced Sensors MultiHAL.

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
* Fixed camera.
* Fixed internal storage (obb) issues.

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
* Fixed up wpa_supplicant config files.
* Cleaned up wpa_supplicant service definitions (rootdir).
* Kanged Wi-Fi HAL from the BQ Aquaris M10 (freezerhd).

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
- Fixed volume keys (kvolcb takes care of them now).
- Fixed external storage permissions (sdcardfs).
- Enabled "show internal storage by default" in File Explorer.
- Added option to reboot to hacked bootloader using ADB (reboot-amonet).
- Disabled the update recovery function (Developer Settings).
- Extended support for {OTG,ext SDs} formats.

name: LineageOS 15.1 for the Amazon Fire HD8 2017
body:
* Fixed OTAs (refractored URI property).
* Fixed Magisk and GAPPs installation (removed liblog shim).
* Signed the build with dev-keys (trust warning should be gone).
* Fixed system size value (should fix error 7).
